overview: 本期共收录 3 篇论文。研究方向主要集中在金融经济学（2 篇）、劳动经济学（1 篇）。方法上以深度学习、随机森林为主。来源分布：OpenAlex（3 篇）。

papers.title: HSSynergy: scale-aware hierarchical attention for interpretable drug synergy prediction
papers.abstract:
Abstract
                    Combination therapy offers a promising strategy for cancer treatment by reducing toxicity and overcoming drug resistance. However, existing substructure-based prediction methods may struggle to effectively capture the scale-specific features of substructure interactions and often overlook cell-line-specific substructure selection, which can limit mechanistic interpretability. To address this issue, we propose HSSynergy, a hierarchical substructure-aware deep learning framework for predicting anticancer drug synergy. It first employs Graph Attention-Convolution Fusion Module to adaptively extract multi-scale substructure features from molecular graphs. Rather than indiscriminately mixing features, it introduces a Scale-Aware Masked Attention mechanism that enforces precise layer-wise alignment, and utilizes hierarchical grouping with mask constraints to achieves same-scale focusing while shielding against cross-scale noise. Furthermore, shifting away from passive cell line representations, a Cell-Active Cross-Attention mechanism models the active selection of specific substructures by heterogeneous cancer cells, capturing precise drug-cell contexts. Rigorous evaluations on two benchmark datasets show that HSSynergy achieves superior performance compared to state-of-the-art methods with robust generalization to unseen drugs and cell lines. Beyond predictive metrics, it provides mechanistic interpretability insights, revealing the hierarchical emergence of substructures and accurately pinpointing literature-validated functional groups driving synergy in specific drug combinations. Notably, several novel synergistic combinations predicted by HSSynergy are supported by existing literature and clinical evidence, suggesting its potential utility in aiding anticancer drug discovery.
                  
                  
                    Scientific contribution
                    HSSynergy (i) Scale-Aware Masked Attention restricts substructure interactions within scale groups to reduce cross-scale noise. (ii) Cell-Active Cross-Attention models dynamic, cell-specific substructure selection instead of static cell-line fusion. (iii)Hierarchical attention links synergy predictions to pharmacologically functional groups.

papers.title: Deteksi Domain DGA menggunakan Random Forest Berdasarkan Karakteristik String dengan Evaluasi Unseen Family
papers.abstract: Domain Generation Algorithm (DGA) is a mechanism used by malware to algorithmically generate domain names as candidate destinations for communication with command and control servers. Domain string characteristics can be used to distinguish algorithmically generated domains from legitimate domains. This study aims to identify DGA domains based on string characteristics using Random Forest and evaluate its performance against DGA families not observed during training. The dataset consists of 20,000 balanced domains, comprising 10,000 DGA domains from 52 families and 10,000 legitimate domains. A total of 21 features were extracted, including domain length, name length, character counts and ratios, unique character counts, domain structure, and Shannon entropy. Evaluation was conducted using Random Stratified Split and Unseen Family Split. Random Stratified Split achieved 91.83% accuracy, 92.14% precision, 91.45% recall, and 91.79% F1-score. Unseen Family Split achieved 85.55% accuracy, 91.47% precision, 78.41% recall, and 84.44% F1-score. The results indicate a change in classification performance when the model encounters unseen DGA families. Feature importance identified name length and the ratio of name length to domain length as the two most important features. The findings provide an evaluation basis for DGA classification under unseen-family conditions.

papers.title: AGRICULTURAL LIVELIHOOD DIVERSIFICATION THROUGH AGRITOURISM AND RURAL ENTERPRISES: AN EXPERIMENTAL STUDY OF TEA-GARDEN HOUSEHOLDS IN THE DOOARS, WEST BENGAL, INDIA
papers.venue: EPRA International Journal of Agriculture and Rural Economic Research
papers.abstract: Tea-garden households in the Dooars region of West Bengal, India, remain heavily dependent on tea-plucking wages, while limited access to productive agricultural enterprises constrains opportunities for livelihood diversification. This study examines whether an integrated agricultural livelihood diversification model combining agritourism, tea-tourism experiences, apiculture, community-based homestays, skills development, and productive utilization of tea-processing residues can strengthen household economic resilience and reduce dependence on tea-wage employment. A quasi-experimental longitudinal design is employed across eight intervention and four matched comparison villages in the Dooars region of Jalpaiguri district. Household data are collected at baseline, midline, and endline to measure changes in household income, employment, agricultural and allied-enterprise participation, livelihood diversification, and dependence on tea-wage income and forest resources. A Difference-in-Differences (DiD) framework is used to estimate intervention-associated changes between treatment and comparison villages, while enterprise-level unit-economic analysis assesses the financial viability of apiculture, homestays, agritourism activities, and tea-residue-based value addition. The study conceptualizes agritourism as a mechanism for strengthening agricultural value chains by connecting tea landscapes, local agricultural products, farm-based experiences, accommodation and rural entrepreneurship. The integrated model is expected to generate additional income and employment, increase participation in diversified agricultural and allied enterprises, strengthen local skills, and promote circular utilization of tea-processing residues. The study contributes empirical evidence on how agritourism and complementary agricultural enterprises can support livelihood diversification among tea-garden communities and provides a potentially scalable framework for other tea-growing regions of India and the Eastern Himalaya.
papers.summary_zh: 【劳动经济学】印度西孟加拉邦杜阿尔斯地区的茶园家庭仍然高度依赖采茶工资收入，而有限的生产性农业企业发展机会限制了他们实现生计多样化的途径。本研究探讨了一种综合性的农业生计多样化模式——该模式结合了农业旅游、茶文化旅游体验、养蜂业、社区民宿服务、技能培训以及对茶叶加工废弃物的有效利用——是否能够增强家庭的经济韧性，并减少对采茶工资收入的依赖。研究采用了准实验性纵向设计方法，在贾尔帕伊古里区杜阿尔斯地区的8个干预村和4个对照村进行了调查。研究人员在基线期、中期和结束时收集了家庭数据，以衡量家庭收入、就业情况、农业及相关企业参与度、生计多样化程度以及对茶叶工资收入和森林资源的依赖程度的变化。通过差异-in-差异（DiD）方法分析了干预组与对照组之间的变化情况，同时通过企业层面的经济分析评估了养蜂业、民宿服务、农业旅游活动以及基于茶叶废弃物的增值项目的财务可行性。研究将农业旅游视为一种通过连接茶园景观、当地农产品、农场体验、住宿设施和农村创业活动来强化农业价值链的机制。这一综合模式有望创造额外收入和就业机会，提高人们对多元化农业及相关企业的参与度，提升当地劳动力技能，并促进茶叶加工废弃物的循环利用。该...。研究方法：双重差分、实验方法。
